name: bar_chart
description: A horizontal progress bar that fills based on a metric's current value relative to its maximum. Ideal for visualizing disk usage, memory consumption, and individual CPU thread loads.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric to visualize as a progress bar.

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: The maximum value the bar represents. The bar fills to 100% when the metric reaches this value.

config.name: color
config.label: Color
config.description: The fill color of the bar under normal conditions.

config.name: back_color
config.label: Back Color
config.description: The background color of the unfilled portion of the bar.

config.name: warning_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: The percentage of the max value at which the bar switches to the warning color.

config.name: warning_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The fill color of the bar when the metric exceeds the warning threshold.

config.name: critical_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: The percentage of the max value at which the bar switches to the critical color.

config.name: critical_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The fill color of the bar when the metric exceeds the critical threshold.
